_about: Beyond Chaos strangejourney: SNES short entrances (US v1.0, maps 0-414, as BC reads them) -> PR doors, and SNES destinations -> PR arrivals (tools/bc_entrances.py index). entrances[]: map, index (BC's entid: the raw table index), x, y, dest_word, dest (map), flags, dest_x, dest_y, bc_shuffles (BC's vortex may deal it a new destination), doors (PR objects with a map_id: file under the game's assets, Tiled object id, layer, PR tile, current map_id/point_id; how: spot / near (a tile off) / twin (an unclaimed neighbour with the same destination); dest_agrees: the object's own destination is the SNES one; shared_with: other SNES entrances holding the same PR door), shared_with (all of them), reason when none. destinations{'map:x:y'}: arrivals [{pr, map_id, point_id (an existing PointIn) or null + new_point (a PointIn to add at pr_x, pr_y in file), how: door (vanilla's matched doors land there) / point (a PointIn within a tile of the spot on a PR room of the map) / new_point}], first = vanilla's choice; reason when none. rooms_found: PR rooms of SNES maps this index found by following doors (beyond data/snes_pr_maps.json).
